author: James Joyce
title: Dubliners
edition: New York: B. W. Huebsch, second printing, April 1917 (US first printing December 1916); scan-backed Wikisource transcription of 1917 Dubliners by James Joyce.djvu. HTML emphasis becomes plain text; page-number markers and zero-width page-boundary characters removed, prose line wrapping folded to spaces; original paragraph and embedded verse boundaries retained. The printed row of spaced full stops marking the section break in Eveline (p. 47) is reproduced as its own line of nine spaced periods. The library text holds all fifteen stories in the book's order, each under its printed title; the title page and contents are omitted.

rights.basis: The English text in this 1917 edition was published before 1931; its US publication copyright term has expired as of 2026. The linked primary transcription/catalogue identifies its US public-domain status. No later editorial introduction is included.

acquisition.method: Wikisource MediaWiki parse API (action=parse, prop=text), one request per story subpage in printed order: The Sisters, An Encounter, Araby, Eveline, After the Race, Two Gallants, The Boarding House, A Little Cloud, Counterparts, Clay, A Painful Case, Ivy Day in the Committee Room, A Mother, Grace, The Dead (main-namespace revisions 14966105, 5179127, 6617246, 5179133, 5179150, 5179157, 5917680, 10774318, 5930415, 10774329, 9933978, 5930417, 10774324, 6587783, 14966104). downloadSha256 is the SHA-256 of the fifteen JSON responses concatenated in that order; downloadUrl is the first of them. Only the transcluded scan text (div.prp-pages-output) is used: Wikisource headers, notes, audio links, page-number anchors and zero-width page-boundary characters removed; HTML emphasis dropped to plain text; whitespace collapsed to single spaces; HTML line breaks kept as stanza lines, blank lines between verse lines splitting stanzas; each story's centred title became a heading; the Eveline section-break row of dots is written as nine spaced full stops, as the edition note states.
